messages:
Maria Chen: Quick sync — kicking off a short sprint to get the marketplace listings activated in staging for AWS / GCP / Azure. Goal: publisher accounts provisioned, test offers in staging, and basic billing mapping by EOD next Tuesday.

Akshay Patel: Sounds good. I can handle AWS and Azure publisher access. Need the exact email for the AWS publisher account and the org SID for Azure.

Maria Chen: AWS publisher email = redwood-marketplace@redwood.ai (placeholder), Azure org SID = 78a2-xx-az. Use those only for staging. I'll confirm final creds with infra.

James O'Neil: For GCP I need the project ID and whether we should use a service account or user-level owner to grant publisher perms. Recommendation: service account with limited roles.

Sana Rodriguez: Agree with James — SA + limited roles. Also: packaging question — are we shipping AMI images for AWS or just container marketplace listing?

Akshay Patel: For initial test listing we'll do container-based listing (ECR) and a simple AMI placeholder for AWS marketplace compliance. Later we can swap in optimized AMIs.

Priya (Legal): Pricing/legal check: please attach final pricing tiers and trial terms before we push to staging. We need to confirm EULA language variant for EU customers.

Maria Chen: Noted @Priya — attaching the pricing matrix v0.1 in this thread (see link). We'll default to 14-day trial and pay-as-you-go SKU for staging.

partnerships-bot: Reminder: marketplace checklist assigned to @Akshay Patel, @James O'Neil, @Sana Rodriguez. Due: 1738098745.

Akshay Patel: Quick IAM snippet for Azure we used before: ```az role assignment create --assignee <sa-principal> --role "Contributor" --scope /subscriptions/<sub-id>/resourceGroups/<rg>``` Use Contributor only for staging resources, not production.

James O'Neil: GCP SA roles: roles/owner not needed. Use roles/compute.admin + roles/servicemanagement.serviceController for marketplace publish flow.

Sana Rodriguez: Packaging checklist: 1) Container image tag (staging:v1) 2) Dockerfile with start script 3) Marketplace metadata (logos, screenshots) 4) AMI stub for AWS 5) Trial SKU mapping. I'll assemble assets and drop in the shared drive by tomorrow.

Maria Chen: Thanks. Action items: Akshay = AWS + Azure publisher creds & staging AMI stub; James = GCP project SA + marketplace roles; Sana = packaging assets + metadata; Priya = EULA/pricing signoff. I'll run the staging publish on Wednesday and report back.

Akshay Patel: On it. Will ping once creds are set. :thumbsup:

James O'Neil: I'll create the SA and post the key in the secrets channel (encrypted).

Priya (Legal): I'll review pricing matrix EOD today and flag any EU-specific language.

Maria Chen: Cool — if no blockers let's aim to have a smoke publish by Wed afternoon. If anything urgent call me or drop in #release-war-room.

partnerships-bot: Thread closed for inactivity after 72h without updates (automated).
